plan.source: Existing benchmark-camera, weather/quality/exposure controls and visual-capture-bundle. Matrix uses the existing render-program-matrix button.
plan.scope: Fixed city frames do not move the car and do not prove a route. Foundry-work-bay is the existing maintenance-court camera south of the exact navigation endpoint; terrace-arrival is the existing cross-level connection camera. Actual endpoint driving is a separate native-key run.
plan.preservation: Original PNG and same-frame JSON extracted byte-for-byte from the application ZIP; ZIP CRC and every PNG decode are verified. Source pixels are never generated, retouched or resized.
